exposure: WINROP algorithm (based on gestational age, birth weight, and weekly weight gain)
outcome: Sight-threatening retinopathy of prematurity (type 1 or type 2 ROP)
cohort: The study included 365 Egyptian preterm infants with a mean gestational age of approximately 31.24 weeks and a mean birth weight of approximately 1508.78 grams.
finding: The WINROP algorithm demonstrated low sensitivity (51.6%) and high specificity (86.2%) for detecting type 1 or type 2 Retinopathy of Prematurity.
